0022600096.text: The Orlando Magic (0-1, 11th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, one game back) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (1-0, 7th in the West and 3rd in the Northwest) in the Magic's second game of the season. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery) and Noah Penda (out, hamstring), while Anthony Black (ankle sprain) and Jonathan Isaac (knee) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Magic won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 132-120 in Orlando on April 8, 2026.
